pipeline: GitHub Actions -> GHCR -> Azure Container Apps

model.name: logistic_regression
model.bundle_validation: validate_model_bundle() runs at startup; a mismatched bundle fails the app rather than serving wrong numbers silently

prediction.note: a real model ran in the deployed container and returned a cost-aware decision, not a stub

verified.secret_audit: clean: 0 API keys, 0 JWTs, 0 passwords in the evidence files

authority_matrix_enforced_at_startup.observed: starting with CREDITFLOW_API_KEY_ROLE=analyst was refused: 'not a credit authority level; expected one of RISK_COMMITTEE_L2, SYSTEM_STP, UNDERWRITER_L1'. The app refused to come up holding an identity it cannot rank.

unauthenticated_on_a_public_url: POST /predict - model oracle; takes features, returns a score, reads no stored customer row
GET /drift - training reference aggregates including n_rows=3500
exposure.assessment: Scoped auth is by design in the repo (tests/test_api_auth.py scopes auth to money-moving and PII endpoints). No customer data is exposed. But a public URL turns /predict into an unauthenticated model oracle, which is recorded as HIGH severity in deployment terms rather than quietly marked PASS.

not_demonstrated_here.point_in_time_invariant: feature_timestamp > prediction_timestamp must not participate. This lives in pipeline/feature_store/ and is not on the HTTP serving path; it is verified by the repository test suite (410 tests), not by this Azure run.
not_demonstrated_here.degraded_endpoints: GET /llm/info and GET /audit/{id} return 500 because httpx and langgraph are lazy dependencies deliberately excluded from the image. They fail loudly with a stack trace in the container log rather than degrading to a clean error message.

cost_configuration.public_wording: Deployed on Azure Container Apps Consumption with scale-to-zero and usage kept within the available free grant during verification.
